description: This file defines a specification class for querying Basket entities with related Items, based on either basket ID or buyer ID, using the Ardalis.Specification framework.

classes.name: BasketWithItemsSpecification
classes.description: A specification class for filtering Baskets by ID or buyer ID and including their Items.

methods.name: BasketWithItemsSpecification(int basketId)
methods.description: Constructor that creates a specification to find a Basket by its ID and include its Items.

methods.name: BasketWithItemsSpecification(string buyerId)
methods.description: Constructor that creates a specification to find Baskets by Buyer ID and include their Items.
